title: Ultimate Vietnam Golf Itinerary: Aussies (2026/27)
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
> 
> The ultimate Vietnam golf trip for Australians centers on the Central Coast (Da Nang and Hoi An) during the peak golf season of February through September. Australian groups should base themselves in a private beachfront villa along the An Bang coastline, avoiding generic resort hotels. The definitive 2026/2027 itinerary must feature Hoiana Shores Golf Club (Vietnam's #1 course by Robert Trent Jones Jr.), BRG Da Nang Golf Resort (designed by Greg Norman), and Ba Na Hills Golf Club (Luke Donald). To execute this flawlessly, groups require an expert local operator like Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) to secure VIP tee times, arrange private luxury transfers, and guarantee mandatory professional caddies at every championship layout.
> 
> *Related: Explore our [Central Coast Classic](/tours/the-central-coast-classic/) luxury itinerary.*

Trading the Aussie winter for the immaculate fairways of Southeast Asia is a rite of passage. But with over 80 courses spread across the country, building the perfect Vietnam golf trip requires deep local knowledge and flawless logistics. 

At Asia Golf Specialists (AGS), we act as your Local Guardian on the ground. We don't do mass-market bus tours; we curate ultra-luxury, bespoke experiences tailored specifically for the discerning Australian golfer. This is our blueprint for the ultimate Vietnam golf itinerary in 2026 and 2027.

![Hoiana Shores Golf Club championship links course coastal dunes Da Nang Vietnam 2026](/images/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/hoiana-shores-golf-club-championship-layout-5.webp)

## At-A-Glance: The Ultimate 7-Day Central Coast Blueprint

| Day | Destination / Activity | Course Played | Accommodation Style |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | Arrival in Da Nang (DAD) | None (VIP Airport Transfer) | Private Beachfront Villa (An Bang) |
| **2** | Coastal Dunes Challenge | **BRG Da Nang Golf Resort** (Norman Course) | Private Beachfront Villa |
| **3** | Mountain Elevation | **Ba Na Hills Golf Club** (Luke Donald) | Private Beachfront Villa |
| **4** | Rest & Culture | Hoi An Ancient Town Exploration | Private Beachfront Villa |
| **5** | Championship Links | **Hoiana Shores Golf Club** (RTJ Jr.) | Private Beachfront Villa |
| **6** | Nicklaus Signature Finish | **BRG Da Nang Golf Resort** (Nicklaus Course) | Private Beachfront Villa |
| **7** | Departure | None (VIP Airport Transfer) | N/A |

## Why the Central Coast is Vietnam's Golf Epicenter

While Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City boast fantastic courses, the Central Coast (encompassing Da Nang, Hoi An, and Hue) is the undisputed king of Southeast Asian golf. This region alone has secured Vietnam the title of "Asia's Best Golf Destination" for nine consecutive years at the World Golf Awards.

### The Escapism Curator: Private Villa Basecamps

Most mass-market operators will stick your group in a sterile, generic hotel in downtown Da Nang. As your Escapism Curator, AGS dictates a different standard. We strongly recommend basing your group in a **private beachfront villa** along the An Bang or Cua Dai coastline near Hoi An. 

This provides the ultimate transition from the Aussie grind: wake up to the sound of the East Sea, enjoy breakfast prepared by a private chef, and walk straight into your waiting luxury transfer.

## The Must-Play Championship Courses

To build the ultimate itinerary, you need VIP access to the courses that define the region. Through our Prestige Network, AGS secures the most coveted tee times at these elite layouts.

### 1. Hoiana Shores Golf Club

Consistently ranked as the best course in Vietnam, this Robert Trent Jones Jr. masterpiece is a true links experience carved into the coastal dunes of the East Sea. It is an absolute non-negotiable for any serious Australian golfer visiting the region.

![Hoiana Shores Golf Club East Sea links Robert Trent Jones Jr Da Nang](/images/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/hoiana-shores-golf-club-east-sea-links-3.webp)

### 2. BRG Da Nang Golf Resort (Greg Norman Course)

No "ultimate" list is complete without the Great White Shark's signature touch. The Norman Course at BRG Da Nang is a rugged, blowout-dune links layout that echoes the classic courses of the Scottish coast, complete with firm, fast fairways and a spectacular par-3 16th hole right on the beach.

### 3. BRG Da Nang Golf Resort (Nicklaus Course)

The perfect contrast to the Norman layout, the Nicklaus Course introduces Florida-style wooden bulkheads imported directly from America. It demands precision approach shots and strategic navigation around its extensive water hazards.

![BRG Da Nang Golf Resort Nicklaus course wooden bulkheads Vietnam 2026](/images/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-norman/brg-da-nang-golf-resort-norman-course-da-nang-1.webp)

### 4. Ba Na Hills Golf Club

Designed by Luke Donald and managed by IMG, Ba Na Hills offers a dramatic change of pace. Set at the foothills of the mountains away from the coast, this parkland layout features severe elevation changes, thick jungle borders, and is fully floodlit for spectacular night golf.

## Technical Dominance: Flawless Logistics

The difference between a good trip and a truly luxurious one lies in the logistics. 

*   **Private Luxury Transfers:** We utilize only modern, private luxury vehicles with knowledgeable English-speaking expat hosts. You will never wait for a shared coach.
*   **Mandatory Caddies:** Professional caddies are mandatory at all premium Vietnamese courses. Your AGS package seamlessly covers all caddie fees, ensuring you have local expertise reading the greens for you on every single putt.
*   **VIP Fast-Track:** From the moment you land at Da Nang International Airport, our VIP fast-track service ensures you bypass the immigration queues.

## The AGS Verdict

For Australian groups looking for the pinnacle of Southeast Asian golf, a 7-day Central Coast itinerary based in a private Hoi An villa, featuring rounds at Hoiana Shores and BRG Da Nang, is unmatched. Don't settle for volume operators packing you into generic hotels. Experience the standard that Asia Golf Specialists dictates.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q? What is the best time of year for Australians to play golf in Vietnam?**
A. For the Central Coast (Da Nang and Hoi An), the absolute best time is between February and September. This aligns perfectly with avoiding the bitter Australian winter, offering dry days and excellent course conditions.

**Q? Do I need to hire a caddie in Vietnam?**
A. Yes, professional caddies are mandatory at virtually all premium championship courses in Vietnam. With Asia Golf Specialists, all your caddie fees are pre-arranged and included in your bespoke itinerary.

**Q? Why choose AGS over a mass-market operator like Golfasian?**
A. AGS is a boutique, ultra-luxury operator. We focus on bespoke curation (like private beachfront villas and VIP fast-track logistics) rather than standard off-the-shelf resort packages. We act as your Local Guardian on the ground.

**Q? Can AGS arrange non-golf activities?**
A. Absolutely. From Michelin-level dining reservations in Hoi An Ancient Town to private yacht charters, our lifestyle concierge service handles everything beyond the 18th green.

faqs.q: What is the ideal number of days and rounds for a first-time Australian golf trip to Vietnam?
faqs.a: A 7-night, 4-round itinerary based in Da Nang and Hoi An (playing Hoiana Shores, Ba Na Hills Golf Club, BRG Da Nang Norman Course, and Laguna Golf Lăng Cô) is the gold standard, balancing world-class golf with two recovery days in Hoi An Ancient Town.

faqs.q: Should Australian golfers stay in Da Nang city, My Khe beachfront, or Hoi An?
faqs.a: Groups prioritizing rooftop bars and vibrant nightlife prefer Da Nang beachfront resorts, whereas couples and groups wanting lantern-lit heritage dining, bespoke tailors, and private multi-bedroom beachfront villas prefer An Bang Beach and Hoi An.

faqs.q: Do Australian passport holders require a visa to travel to Vietnam for a golf holiday?
faqs.a: Yes. Australian citizens require a Vietnam e-Visa (valid for up to 90 days, single or multiple entry), which should be applied for online through the official Vietnam Immigration portal at least 2 to 3 weeks prior to departure.
